verses.text: "What a help you've been to someone who has no power! What a rescue for an arm with no strength!
What advice you've given to someone without wisdom! How much sound knowledge you've shared!
Who were you speaking to? Whose spirit spoke through you?
The spirits of the dead tremble beneath the waters and all that live in them.
Sheol lies bare before God, and Abaddon has nothing to cover it.
He stretches the northern skies over empty space and hangs the earth on nothing.
He wraps the waters in thick clouds, yet the clouds don't burst under their weight.
He covers the face of his throne and spreads his cloud over it.
He draws a boundary on the surface of the waters where light meets darkness.
The pillars of heaven tremble and stand in shock at his rebuke.
By his power he stirs up the sea, and by his understanding he strikes down Rahab.
His Spirit makes the heavens beautiful. His hand pierces the swift serpent.
And these are only the edges of what he does. We hear so faint a whisper of him. Who can understand the thunder of his power?"
